design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value for the CPS score, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that student weights were included in all estimations, indicating proper application of sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering, indicating that student-level models were used without considering school-level effects.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
